description: Tasks 3.5 + 3.6: the text recognizers (PP-OCRv5 ONNX default + Tesseract fallback, EN+ID) with the single-owning fallback decision in build_text_recognizer, plus the pipeline/ page assembler that merges ingest->layout->reading-order->recognition into a typed PageResult/DocumentResult (reusing the M2 pix2tex FormulaRecognizer for all math), and the synchronous POST /pages/recognize API seam. Depends on FEAT-003 (layout + reading order) and FEAT-002 (ingest).
steps: Edit engine/texora_engine/recognizers/base.py: add TextLine(text, bbox:BBox, confidence 0..1, confidence_kind=ConfidenceKind.TOKEN_LOGPROB), TextResult(lines, status:RecognitionStatus=OK, engine_id, detail:str|None), and the @runtime_checkable TextRecognizer Protocol (id, model_ids, langs:tuple[str,...], recognize(image, ctx:RegionContext)->TextResult; catches own errors -> status=FAILED, never raises/fabricates). Reuse the existing BBox from layout/base.py (import it) or define BBox once and import it in both -- keep ONE BBox definition across layout+text; do not duplicate.

Create engine/texora_engine/recognizers/text_factory.py mirroring the formula/layout factories, implementing the single-owning fallback decision in build_text_recognizer EXACTLY per design S7.2.1: read stages.recognize.text; None -> TextStageNotConfigured; unknown -> UnknownTextEngineError; explicit 'tesseract' -> _build_tesseract(settings) with no model-store resolution (raises TesseractUnavailable -> API 409 if the binary is unusable); otherwise resolve specs = {mid: model_store.require_ready(mid) for mid in entry.model_ids}; on ModelNotReady, if settings.recognize.text_fallback_to_tesseract AND _tesseract_available(settings) -> INFO-logged Tesseract degrade, else re-raise (API maps to 409). _tesseract_available = the tesseract binary resolves (settings.recognize.tesseract_cmd else PATH) AND pytesseract.get_tesseract_version() succeeds. Expose known_text_engine_ids().

Create engine/texora_engine/recognizers/text_ppocr_onnx.py: id='pp_ocrv5_onnx', model_ids=('pp_ocrv5_det','pp_ocrv5_rec'), langs=('en','id'). PpOcrV5TextRecognizer(det_onnx:Path, rec_onnx:Path, dict_path:Path, langs, device). onnxruntime det+rec; decode rec class indices to characters via rec_keys.txt; real per-line confidence -> TOKEN_LOGPROB. On inference error -> TextResult(status=FAILED, lines=[]), never a guess. CUDA EP when device=='cuda' (code-review-only on this host, flag PENDING).

Create engine/texora_engine/recognizers/text_tesseract.py: id='tesseract', model_ids=(), langs=('en','id'). TesseractTextRecognizer(langs, tesseract_cmd:str|None, data_dir:str|None). pytesseract.image_to_data with lang='eng+ind'; per-word confidence normalized 0..1 -> TextLines. On error -> status=FAILED.

Create engine/texora_engine/pipeline/page_result.py: RunKind StrEnum (text/math); InlineRun(kind, text:str|None, latex:str|None, mathml:str|None, status=OK, confidence=0.0, confidence_kind=UNAVAILABLE, engine_id='', detail); RegionContent(region:Region, inlines:list[InlineRun], text:str|None, latex:str|None, mathml:str|None, status, confidence, confidence_kind, engine_id, detail); PageResult(index, width, height, dpi, kind, contents:list[RegionContent], status); DocumentResult(source_name, pages:list[PageResult]). All Pydantic v2 (design S7.3).

Create engine/texora_engine/pipeline/assembler.py: PipelineDeps bundling the built layout detector + text recognizer + formula recognizer (reuse recognizers.factory.build_formula_recognizer) + settings. assemble_page(rendered:RenderedPage, image:Image, deps)->PageResult per design S7.4: (1) preprocess (skip for clean born-digital); (2) layout -- born-digital structural detector when rendered.kind==PDF_BORN_DIGITAL else the configured LayoutDetector; (3) reading_order.order(regions, rendered.width, rendered.height); (4) per-region recognition under a per-region timeout via the single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor + asyncio.wait_for pattern (design S7.5): text-ish regions build the ordered inlines run list (TEXT runs from the text recognizer, or the born-digital text-layer text directly; inline MATH runs from the reused pix2tex FormulaRecognizer on the math sub-crop), INLINE_MATH/DISPLAY_MATH crops ALWAYS re-recognized via pix2tex -> validate_and_normalize (ensemble/latex.py) -> latex_to_mathml (export/mathml.py), EQUATION_NUMBER attached to its display math, TABLE -> status=needs_review detail 'table recognition is M6' (never fabricated), FIGURE crop saved to the output asset dir, HANDWRITING -> needs_review detail 'handwriting path is M6'; build RegionContext(is_display=..., device=settings.device, source='page') per region (design N4); (5) status roll-up = worst of regions (failed>needs_review>ok); (6) free the bitmap (image.close()) + crops before returning. No cross-page state (M4-ready).
Create engine/texora_engine/pipeline/__init__.py re-exporting assemble_page + the result models.

Create engine/texora_engine/api/pages.py: POST /pages/recognize on a bearer-protected router (protected_router pattern). Accept a validated/sanitized file path (existing regular file under an allowed root, no .. traversal, accepted extension) OR an uploaded image + options (DPI override clamped to [72,max_dpi], preprocess toggles, page range ints in [0,page_count) with start<=end). Build/cache the PipelineDeps on app.state (lazy, like the M2 formula singleton). Run the assembler synchronously over the document; return DocumentResult. Error mapping identical to recognize.py: ModelNotReady/TesseractUnavailable -> 409; UnknownTextEngineError/StageNotConfigured/misconfig -> 500; bad path/range/decode -> 422.
Edit engine/texora_engine/api/__init__.py to export the new pages_router, and engine/texora_engine/app.py to mount it and initialize app.state.pipeline_deps=None.
Extend engine/tests/conftest.py prefetched_models_dir (or add helpers) so the new ONNX + Tesseract-gated tests can locate prefetched artifacts and skip-with-reason when absent.

Write engine/tests/test_text_factory.py (the full design S7.2.1 decision table: PP present->PP; absent+fallback+usable->Tesseract (INFO degrade, engine_id stamped); absent+fallback+not-usable->409 ModelNotReady re-raise; absent+no-fallback->409; explicit tesseract + missing binary->TesseractUnavailable; built.id == configured id; monkeypatch _tesseract_available/require_ready), test_text_ppocr.py + test_text_tesseract.py (@pytest.mark.model/binary-gated real fixtures text_en.png/text_id.png -> non-empty sane EN+ID text when available else skip-with-reason; failure injection -> FAILED never raises), test_assembler.py (@pytest.mark.model integration on born_digital_math.pdf via the REAL pix2tex + text engines: asserts region types, reading order, one display equation with latex, one inline-math run; skip-with-reason when weights absent, never mocked), and test_pages_api.py (200 + DocumentResult on the fixture when weights present; 401 without token; 409 when a model is absent; 422 on a bad path/range).
acceptance_criteria: `pytest tests/test_text_factory.py tests/test_pages_api.py -q` passes (the API error-mapping + fallback decision tests run without weights).
build_text_recognizer resolves the design S7.2.1 decision table deterministically for every row and the built adapter's id matches the configured id.

The assembler produces a typed PageResult/DocumentResult whose structure (region types + reading order + inline-math placement) matches the expected on born_digital_math.pdf (model-gated; skips with reason when weights absent, never mocked).
TABLE/HANDWRITING regions are marked needs_review with a detail (never fabricated); every unrecognized region is needs_review/failed.
POST /pages/recognize returns 200+DocumentResult on the fixture (weights present), 401 without token, 409 when a model is absent, 422 on a bad path/range.
verification: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_text_ppocr.py tests/test_text_tesseract.py tests/test_assembler.py -q

cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check . && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m black --check . --line-length 100 && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m mypy texora_engine && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q
